provenance: synthetic teaching cases, not runtime observations
capability: fixed internal version-client path; separate bounded DNS/port host probes

cases.task: Draw client namespace, DNS, Service, EndpointSlice, Pod port and HTTP route.
cases.expected: Each layer has a distinct observation and possible failure.

cases.task: The starter contains only the Deployment. Add the hello Service (selector app=hello, port 8080 named http, targetPort http), then Run the Deployment and Service under a qualified lease.
cases.expected: Owned backend identity and exact /version response pass, with cleanup.

cases.task: Interpret a host-provided failed name-resolution trace.
cases.expected: Investigate name, namespace and DNS context before backend application state.

cases.task: Interpret resolution success followed by a bounded connection failure.
cases.expected: Inspect ports, eligible endpoints and qualified policy evidence; cause remains conditional until discriminated.

cases.task: Compare 404 at /missing and 200 with a wrong version.
Specify a wrong-port or cross-namespace test only under a named host capability.
cases.expected: Explicit target, allowed client, timeout, expected layer failure and cleanup are recorded.
